seed_rule: Use each registered deterministic case and fixed IK multi-start seed 20260918; no additional RNG seed is supplied by the case launcher.
source_rule: Commit IK fix and this gate before any new run; no source/config change during the gate.
exact_acceptance: all trace.npz arrays with equal shape, dtype, NaN mask, and exact finite values
all native qpos, qvel, command torque, time, and contact-pair rows
exclusions: none; retain failed and incomplete run outputs
failure_rule: Any differing scientific array or discrete decision, failed scorer, or incomplete run fails the same-host gate. Do not weaken this standard after observing results.
